lemma pk_residue:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0: "x0 < r" and xN: "x0 < N"
  shows "\<exists>K. 0 < K \<and> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<K}
    \<and> card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = K \<and> K * r \<le> N + r \<and> N \<le> K * r + r"
proof -
  obtain M where hM: "N = x0 + M + 1"
    using xN by (metis add.commute add_Suc_right less_iff_Suc_add)
  define K where "K = M div r + 1"
  have r0: "r \<noteq> 0" using r by simp
  have hdm: "r * (M div r) + M mod r = M" using Nat.div_add_mod [of M r] by simp
  have hmod: "M mod r < r" using r by simp
  have hdivle: "M div r * r \<le> M" by (rule Nat.div_mult_le_self)
  have hset: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<K}"
  proof (rule set_eqI)
    fix i
    show "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} \<longleftrightarrow> i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<K}"
    proof
      assume hi: "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
      then have iN: "i < N" and im: "i mod r = x0" by auto
      have h1: "r * (i div r) + x0 = i" using Nat.div_add_mod [of i r] im by simp
      have h2: "i div r * r \<le> M" using h1 iN hM by (simp add: mult.commute) linarith
      have h3: "i div r \<le> M div r" using h2 by (simp add: Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le r)
      show "i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<K}"
        using h1 h3 unfolding K_def by (intro image_eqI[of _ _ "i div r"]) (auto simp: mult.commute)
    next
      assume "i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<K}"
      then obtain m where hm: "m < K" and him: "i = x0 + m * r" by auto
      have h2: "m \<le> M div r" using hm unfolding K_def by simp
      have h3: "m * r \<le> M" using h2 by (simp add: Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le r)
      show "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
        using him h3 hM x0 by (auto simp: Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right Nat.mod_eq_of_lt)
    qed
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) {..<K}"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix m m' assume "m \<in> {..<K}" "m' \<in> {..<K}" and eq: "x0 + m * r = x0 + m' * r"

    then show "m = m'" using r0 by simp
  qed

    unfolding hset by (simp add: card_image_of_injOn[OF inj])
  have KR: "K * r \<le> N + r"

  qed

qed

(* the periodic state is normalised *)

lemma pk_final:
  fixes N r L g :: real
  assumes hr: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and hL: "0 < L" and L1: "L * r \<le> N + r"
    and hg: "2 / pi * (N - r) / r \<le> g"

proof -
  have hN: "0 < N" using hr rN by linarith
  have hpi: "0 < pi" by simp
  have hNr: "0 \<le> N - r" using rN by linarith
  have a0: "0 \<le> 2 / pi * (N - r) / r"
    by (intro divide_nonneg mult_nonneg) (use hNr hpi in \<open>auto simp: field_simps\<close>)
  have gg: "(2 / pi * (N - r) / r) ^ 2 \<le> g ^ 2"
    using a0 hg by (intro power_mono) auto
  have r0: "r \<noteq> 0" using hr by simp
  have N0: "N \<noteq> 0" using hN by simp
  have pi0: "pi \<noteq> 0" using hpi by simp
  have e1: "4 / (pi ^ 2 * r) * (1 - r / N) ^ 3 = 4 * (N - r) ^ 3 / (pi ^ 2 * r * N ^ 3)"
    using r0 N0 by (simp add: field_simps)
  have e2: "(2 / pi * (N - r) / r) ^ 2 / (L * N) = 4 * (N - r) ^ 2 / (pi ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * (L * N))"
    using r0 N0 pi0 hL by (simp add: field_simps power_divide)
  have key: "(N - r) * (L * r) \<le> N ^ 2"
  proof -
    have "(N - r) * (L * r) \<le> (N - r) * (N + r)"
      using L1 hNr by (intro mult_left_mono) (simp_all add: mult.commute)
    moreover have "(N - r) * (N + r) = N ^ 2 - r ^ 2" by (simp add: algebra_simps power2_eq_square)
    ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
  qed
  have pos1: "0 < pi ^ 2 * r * N ^ 3"
    using hpi hr hN by (intro mult_pos) auto
  have pos2: "0 < pi ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * (L * N)"
    using hpi hr hL hN by (intro mult_pos) auto
  have step: "4 * (N - r) ^ 3 / (pi ^ 2 * r * N ^ 3) \<le> 4 * (N - r) ^ 2 / (pi ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * (L * N))"
  proof -
    have nn: "0 \<le> 4 * (N - r) ^ 2 * (pi ^ 2 * r * N) * (N ^ 2 - (N - r) * (L * r))"

    have eq: "4 * (N - r) ^ 2 * (pi ^ 2 * r * N ^ 3) - 4 * (N - r) ^ 3 * (pi ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * (L * N))
